parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is intentionally mirrored in the demo harness for local debugging purposes. Consolidating the two would couple the DebugPanel production package to WallpaperSampleApp demo semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
